# Time to treatment switch or stop

**Status: blocked — switch/stop event definition not ready.**

The required future fields are `id`, `treatment_id`, `treatment_line`,
`start_date`, `event_date`, controlled `event_type` (`switch` or `stop`),
`event_reason`, `death_date`, `follow_up_end_date`, and an indicator that the
event history is complete through the censoring date.

The current `treatment_lines` interface exposes only an optional
`treatment_switch_date` and a `stop_date`; it does not establish the first
qualifying event, reason, competing death rule, or observation completeness.
Those fields cannot be inferred safely, so this endpoint remains pending.
